chris (People Ops): Quick note: finalizing the formal appeals window for this cycle. please read and bookmark the form.

ivy (People Ops): TL;DR: Appeals open the day after calibration closes and are open for 5 business days. Use the appeals form — don't DM.

cal (Compensation): Important: appeals can request a review of process or evidence, not automatic compensation changes. compensation adjustments follow after appeal review + calibration chair sign-off.

dana (Manager - ML): Who is eligible to file an appeal?

chris (People Ops): Eligibility: the IC or the manager can file. Appeals must be about new verifiable evidence or documented procedural errors (e.g., reviewer COI, missing packet items, or misapplied rubric).

alex (IC - Eng): Can peers submit an appeal on behalf of someone?

ivy (People Ops): No. Only the IC or their manager may submit. Peers can contact the manager with evidence, but the manager must file.

appeals-bot: Appeals form published: https://redwood.app/forms/appeal?id=AP-2026-01  (Form_id: `AP-2026-01`)

chris (People Ops): Process summary: 1) Submit form w/ evidence links and statement. 2) People Ops triages within 2 business days. 3) If procedural, we can correct (e.g., reassign reviewer). If evidence-based, appeal moves to a 3-person appeals committee (chair + two independent reviewers). 4) Committee issues decision within 7 business days of triage.

cal (Compensation): If committee changes the rating, comp team will re-evaluate impact and notify manager + IC. Any comp change requires chair sign-off and finance review if it affects >$Xk in payouts.

dana (Manager - ML): What counts as "verifiable evidence"?

ivy (People Ops): Dated artifacts: code commits with timestamps, incident tickets (with IDs), pull request history, meeting notes with dates. Screenshots alone are OK if they include timestamps and links to source.

alex (IC - Eng): Are anonymous reports considered? I sometimes get anonymous notes after calibration.

chris (People Ops): Anonymous tips can trigger a People Ops review, but we won't accept anonymous submissions as the formal appeal. Manager must collate and submit with verifiable artifacts.

appeals-bot: Reminder: Appeals open Apr 11 09:00 UTC and close Apr 16 17:00 UTC.

cal (Compensation): Any changes to the public packet after an appeal?

ivy (People Ops): Packets are immutable once shared. If appeal results in a rating change, we'll append an amendment record to the packet and update the chair notes. The IC will be notified with a summary of the committee decision.

dana (Manager - ML): Can appeals request a full re-calibration for a cohort?

chris (People Ops): Only in extreme cases (systemic error affecting >20% of cohort or clear rubric misapplication). Those escalate to the exec review board and have a separate timeline.

alex (IC - Eng): What's the SLA for the People Ops triage? 2 business days seems long when emotions run high.

ivy (People Ops): We aim for 2 business days to allow basic validation. Emergency/clear procedural errors get prioritized same day. We'll send an acknowledgement email within 24 hours.

cal (Compensation): Another note: if an appeal changes comp, the manager must not communicate comp changes to the IC until People Ops confirms and Finance completes approvals. This avoids inconsistent messaging.

chris (People Ops): Communication templates: we added two templates to the appeals form — manager-facing summary and IC-facing outcome. Use those; it standardizes tone and timing.

appeals-bot: Appeals form has required fields: who is filing, role (IC/Manager), affected employee(s), link to packet, list of verifiable evidence, and desired remedy.

ivy (People Ops): Auditing: all appeals and committee notes are logged and retained 5 years for compliance. Access limited to People Ops, chairs, and legal when needed.

dana (Manager - ML): If the committee upholds the original rating, can the filer escalate?

chris (People Ops): Final decision sits with the appeals committee. A re-review request can be submitted only if new evidence surfaces. Exec escalation only for process-level issues.

alex (IC - Eng): Thanks. One operational ask: can the appeals form auto-attach the original packet snapshot? saves manual copy/paste.

ivy (People Ops): Great idea — added. The form will snapshot basic packet metadata (ratings, reviewers, evidence links) into the ticket. No editable copy is included.

calendar-bot: Calendar update: Appeals window opens Apr 11 09:00 UTC. Closing notification Apr 16 17:00 UTC.

chris (People Ops): Final note: please don't post public threads about ongoing appeals in #general. Keep discussions between manager/People Ops until resolution. If you need to flag urgent procedural errors, DM People Ops.

cal (Compensation): We'll add an FAQ blurb in the comp handbook about appeals and timing.

ivy (People Ops): Thanks all. If you want a 10-min office hours to walk through the form, I'll host one tomorrow at 11:00 UTC — RSVP on the events page. :white_check_mark:
